signals.summary: Abacum raised $60m Series B round led by Scale Venture Partners
signals.evidence: Abacum, the business planning software company founded by Julio Martínez and Jorge Lluch, today announces that it has raised a $60m Series B round led by San Francisco‑headquartered Scale Venture Partners.

signals.summary: Abacum expanding rapidly across the U.S. market
signals.evidence: Headquartered in New York, Abacum will use the fresh injection of capital to double down on product innovation and growth, continuing to expand rapidly across the U.S.

signals.summary: Abacum is the leading business planning platform that empowers finance teams to drive performance
signals.evidence: Abacum is the leading business planning platform that empowers finance teams to drive performance.

signals.summary: Abacum’s platform brings financial and operational data into one place in real‑time
signals.evidence: Abacum’s end‑to‑end business planning platform brings financial and operational data into one place in real‑time.

signals.summary: Abacum serves hundreds of mid‑market companies, including Strava, Aiven, JG Wentworth, and Mastercam
signals.evidence: Abacum is used by hundreds of mid‑market companies to drive efficient growth and performance, including industry leaders such as Strava, Aiven, JG Wentworth, and Mastercam.
